IncidentDef.label: concealed Asuran Stargate strike
IncidentDef.letterText: A hostile Lattice signal has resolved through the colony's Stargate. Sensors cannot immediately fix the arriving craft: a Puddle Jumper is holding a finite cloak beside the gate with an Asuran boarding party still physically aboard. Damage, fuel loss or time can collapse the concealment before the exact crew deploys.
